surface.author: Rob Tuytel
surface.metadata_qualification: The current page and numeric dimensions indicate about 0.6 m; the older API scale string says 30x30CM. The selected 0.6 m mapping is an experimental art choice, not a measured geometry fact.

geometry.attachment: Two original iron straps and two hexagonal bolt heads per blade.
geometry.preserved: Source rotor, atlas, center, native axis, scale, signed cosmetic presenter, original paddle envelope and native rules.
geometry.end_grain: No separate end-grain source is claimed.

source_files.representation: 1024-square RGBA8 OpenGL normal PNG. Unused alpha spans 253 to 255.
1024-square grey-plus-alpha PNG. Unused alpha spans 251 to 255.

preparation.unused_alpha: Full loaded RGB hash matches independent raw PNG decoding, and all data pixels compare exactly before/after conversion to float RGB. Alpha is unused by these data roles.
preparation.normal: Float Lanczos resize to 512 square, positive-Z OpenGL normal renormalization and nearest RGB8 encoding.
preparation.roughness: Float Lanczos resize to 512 square and nearest L8 encoding.
preparation.delivery: Lossless WebP pixels compare exactly with the prepared representation. This is not equality to the larger original PNGs.

runtime.grain: Image V follows the blade's longer axial span.
runtime.missing_all_maps: Historical fixed rosters retain the original block paddles and generated wood finish.
runtime.partial_set: Explicit invalid resource status; not sourced success.
runtime.export: The exercised native launcher uses raw project capture. Godot export packaging remains outside this verified resource closure.

evidence: Source, exact preparation and asset fixtures establish only their technical scope. No human quality, force, efficiency, collision or power claim is implied.
